evals.prompt: Matft.stats.ptp を追加したい．np.ptp と同じ挙動で TDD で実装して
evals.expected_output: Matft.stats.ptp implemented test-first with numpy-generated expected values covering axes, dtypes, NaN, empty, layouts
assertions: Expected values come from numpy (a python generator in the patch, or numpy expressions noted next to the literals)
Tests loop over layoutVariants (non-contiguous / view inputs)
Output dtype is asserted (checkType: true or an mftype assertion)
At least three dtypes are tested, including an integer type
NaN or inf inputs are tested
Empty (zero-length) or size-1 inputs are tested
The report contains a viewpoint-by-viewpoint test plan / coverage table
The report states Red (failing before the change) and Green results
Axis cases include nil/all-axes and a negative axis
A performance test is added (reduction = hot path) or its omission is justified
